name: Beijing SinoHytec Co., Ltd.
summary: Beijing SinoHytec Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research and development and commercialization of hydrogen fuel cells in China and internationally. The company provides fuel cell systems and related technology development and services and technical services; provision of combined heat and power systems, PEM electrolyzers, and fuel cell stacks; and energy technology promotion services. The company's products are for use in commercial vehicles, such as buses, logistics vehicles, and heavy trucks. It offers its products and services through commercial vehicle manufacturers. Beijing SinoHytec Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 2012 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.
